Name: Moberly-Jourdain Versailles incident
Summary: 1901 Petit Trianon walk published in 1911; costume gatherings and memory reconstruction proposed; open under sealed-archive test F15.

Name: Edith Olivier, Avebury fair
Summary: 1916 evening drive reporting an vanished village fair; recorded years later after archival reading.

Name: Victor Goddard, RAF Drem
Summary: 1935 flight over disused airfield later recounted in 1960s-1975 books as pre-seeing 1939 yellow trainers; post-hoc retelling.

Name: Kersey cadets
Summary: 1957 Suffolk village walk written down roughly 30 years later; butcher shop registry (1790-1905) matches public local history.

Name: Charlotte Warburton, Tunbridge Wells cafe
Summary: 1968 anecdotal timeslip narrative transmitted through secondary paranormal compilations without contemporaneous log.

Name: Bold Street, Liverpool (Frank)
Summary: 1996 urban folklore account popularized by Slemen (1997) without primary witness record.

Name: Montreal and SPR timeslip collections
Summary: Secondary Society for Psychical Research compilation entries lacking pre-unsealed archival controls.

Name: Time-traveling hipster photo
Summary: 1941 South Fork Bridge reopening photograph (Virtual Museum of Canada): sunglasses, printed sweater, and portable camera are documented 1940s items.

Name: Chaplin's time traveller (The Circus premiere)
Summary: 1928 archival premiere footage showing a pedestrian holding a dark acoustic ear trumpet / Siemens carbon hearing aid.

Name: Newquay beach mobile device
Summary: 1943 Towan Beach photograph showing a man looking down at his hands while rolling a cigarette or winding a watch.

Name: Waldmuller painting phone
Summary: 1860 Ferdinand Georg Waldmuller painting 'The Expected One' depicts a young woman carrying a small hymnal or prayer book.

Name: Rudolph Fentz
Summary: 1876-to-1950 Times Square legend traced by Aubeck directly to Jack Finney's 1951 Collier's science-fiction story 'I'm Scared'.

Name: Man from Taured (John Zegrus case)
Summary: 1959-1960 Tokyo Haneda passport-fraud prosecution of John Allen Kuchar Zegrus, embellished in 1960s-1981 occult paperbacks.

Name: John Titor
Summary: 2000-2001 forum persona claiming arrival from 2036 to retrieve an IBM 5100; specific near-term historical predictions failed.

Name: Andrew Carlssin
Summary: 2003 stock-trading time-traveller arrest story originated as Weekly World News tabloid satire.

Name: Sergei Ponomarenko
Summary: Viral 1958-to-2006 Kyiv photographs traced to staged dramatizations from the 2012 Ukrainian television series 'Aliens'.

Name: Hakan Nordkvist
Summary: 2006 video meeting a future self under a kitchen sink produced as a viral marketing campaign for Swedish pension insurer AMF.

Name: Mike Madman Marcum
Summary: 1995 Coast to Coast AM radio caller narrative claiming a Jacob's-ladder backyard vortex with zero physical verification.

Name: Bob White / Tim Jones (Robert Todino)
Summary: 2003 spam-email time-machine parts request traced to prankster/replier dynamics documented by journalists.

Name: Chronovisor (Pellegrino Ernetti)
Summary: Claimed past-viewing cathode device whose alleged crucifixion photograph matched a postcard of a Collevalenza wood carving.

Name: Die Glocke
Summary: Wunderwaffe bell lore first introduced by Witkowski (2000) without wartime archival documentation.

Name: Philadelphia Experiment
Summary: 1955 Carl Meredith Allen ('Carlos Allende') letters alleging 1943 USS Eldridge teleportation; contradicted by deck logs and crew.

Name: Montauk Project
Summary: 1980s-1992 Preston Nichols pulp narratives extending the Philadelphia hoax via uncorroborated recovered-memory claims.

Name: Mandela effect
Summary: Shared schema-driven false recall (e.g. brand spellings) explained by constructive memory and confabulation without timeline branching.

Name: Aberfan premonitions
Summary: Barker (1967) collected post-disaster letters after the 1966 coal-tip slide; real reports but retrospective with unknown base rate.

Name: British Premonitions Bureau
Summary: 1967-1968 registry collected hundreds of predictions; retrospective hits reflect multiple-hypothesis selection across high volume.

Name: Futility (Morgan Robertson) and Titanic
Summary: 1898 novella drew on contemporary North Atlantic liner engineering; 1912 post-sinking reissue adjusted tonnage and specs.

Name: Lincoln assassination dream
Summary: Recounted years later by Ward Hill Lamon (1895); presidential assassination threats were frequent during the Civil War.

Name: J. W. Dunne, An Experiment with Time
Summary: 1927 dream-diary protocol lacked blinded scoring and pre-registered target hashes, inviting confirmation bias.

Name: Bem 2011 Feeling the Future
Summary: Initial d = 0.22 claim across 9 tasks failed pre-registered replications (Ritchie et al. 2012 p = 0.83; Galak et al. 2012 N = 3,289, d = 0.04).

Name: Presentiment meta-analysis (Mossbridge et al.)
Summary: 2012 meta-analysis reported d = 0.21 pre-stimulus arousal; contested over expectation bias, trial-sequence artifacts, and publication bias.

Name: Stargate / remote viewing (AIR 1995 evaluation)
Summary: 1995 American Institutes for Research review: Utts noted statistical anomalies while Hyman cited methodological flaws and non-replication.

Name: Deja vu (general)
Summary: Reported by ~2/3 of adults across 50+ surveys (Brown 2004); Cleary & Claxton (2018) showed predictive accuracy stays at chance.

Name: Deja vu in temporal lobe epilepsy
Summary: Reproducibly triggered by rhinal/hippocampal aura and direct cortical stimulation, decoupling familiarity signals from episodic retrieval.

Name: Jamais vu
Summary: Transient dissociation of familiarity during semantic satiation or focal seizure without altered external chronology.

Name: Precognitive dreams (general)
Summary: Thousands of nightly dreams per year create high coincidence base rates compounded by morning memory reconstruction.

Name: Aboriginal Dreaming (everywhen)
Summary: Stanner (1953) 'everywhen' ontological tradition encoding landscape, kinship, and deep ecological memory.

Name: Urashima Taro
Summary: 8th-century Japanese chronicle/folklore motif in which days in an undersea palace correspond to centuries ashore.

Name: Oisin in Tir na nOg
Summary: Irish Fenian cycle narrative in which three apparent years in Tir na nOg span three centuries in Ireland.

Name: Rip Van Winkle
Summary: Washington Irving's 1819 literary short story adapting German Peter Klaus folk motifs.

Name: Kakudmi and Revati
Summary: Mahabharata / Bhagavata Purana narrative contrasting Brahma's celestial timescale against elapsed human yugas.

Name: Honi HaMe'agel sleeps 70 years
Summary: Babylonian Talmud Ta'anit 23a parable of a 70-year slumber spanning the destruction and rebuilding of generations.

Name: Seven Sleepers of Ephesus / People of the Cave
Summary: Late-antique Christian and Quranic (Surah Al-Kahf) attested textual tradition of multi-century protective dormancy.

Name: Isra and Mi'raj (Night Journey)
Summary: Attested Islamic textual tradition of a transcendent journey occurring within a brief earthly interval.

Name: Zeitraffer phenomenon
Summary: Cortical lesion / migraine subjective acceleration of perceived visual motion speed.

Name: Akinetopsia (motion blindness)
Summary: Bilateral V5/MT lesion replacing smooth visual motion with discrete static frames without affecting physical clocks.

Name: Alice in Wonderland syndrome (time distortion)
Summary: Transient neurological distortion of perceived duration and spatial scale during migraine or viral encephalitis.

Name: Flash-lag effect and postdiction
Summary: Eagleman & Sejnowski (2000): visual percept integrates events across the following ~80 ms before conscious commitment.

Name: Chronostasis (stopped-clock illusion)
Summary: Saccadic suppression back-fills the post-saccadic target onto the saccade interval, stretching the first perceived second.

Name: Slow motion during danger (free-fall study)
Summary: Stetson et al. (2007) free-fall chronometer test found no temporal resolution gain; denser amygdala encoding inflates retrospective duration.

Name: Near-death life review
Summary: Panoramic autobiographical recall under acute hypoxia/hypercarbia reading stored past-cone traces.

Name: Missing time in abduction narratives
Summary: Sleep paralysis, hypnagogic hallucination, and suggestive interview confabulation accounting for perceived gaps.

Name: OPERA superluminal neutrinos
Summary: 2011 apparent 73 ns early neutrino arrival traced to a loose fiber-optic timing connector and oscillator drift; corrected v = c.

Name: Nimtz superluminal microwave tunnelling
Summary: Evanescent barrier attenuates trailing pulse components while front velocity never exceeds c (Winful 2006); zero early signalling.

Name: Gain-assisted negative group velocity
Summary: Wang, Kuzmich & Dogariu (2000) anomalous dispersion shifts smooth pulse peak forward from leading-edge analyticity; causal front <= c.

Name: Hartman effect and Larmor-clock tunnelling time
Summary: Ramos et al. (2020) Larmor-clock measurement on postselected transmitted Rb atoms; transmitted fraction decays exponentially with barrier width.

Name: Delayed-choice quantum eraser
Summary: Kim et al. (2000): interference fringes appear only after post-hoc coincidence sorting with classical idler records; marginal signal never changes.

Name: Wheeler delayed choice (Jacques et al.)
Summary: 2007 space-like separated interferometer choice confirms complementarity without backward classical messaging.

Name: Negative time photons in an atom cloud
Summary: Angulo et al. (2024) negative atomic excitation dwell time reflects narrowband resonant phase shift, not reception before emission.

Name: Retrocausal interpretations of quantum mechanics
Summary: TSVF, Leifer-Pusey, and Price-Wharton reproduce standard Born-rule marginals and inherit exact no-signalling.

Name: Apparent superluminal jets
Summary: Relativistic AGN jets moving near c at small viewing angle produce apparent transverse speed > c while true speed stays < c.

Name: Hafele-Keating flying clocks
Summary: 1971 circumnavigating caesium clocks confirmed kinematic and gravitational proper-time offsets predicted by relativity.

Name: GPS relativistic correction
Summary: Satellite clocks gain ~38.6 us/day (+45.8 us gravitational minus 7.2 us kinematic) relative to geoid; engineered continuously.

Name: Sergei Krikalev, about 0.02 s into the future
Summary: 803 cumulative days in low Earth orbit produced ~22.7 ms net kinematic time dilation into the Earth-frame future.

Name: Optical-clock dilation at 33 cm and 1 mm
Summary: Chou et al. (2010) at 33 cm and Bothwell et al. (2022) across a 1 mm Sr cloud confirmed g*dh/c^2 = 1.09e-19/mm.

Name: 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami animal flight
Summary: Eyewitness reports of animals moving inland prior to wave arrival; acoustic/infrasound and ground-Rayleigh wave cues plausible.

Name: Common toads before L'Aquila earthquake
Summary: Grant & Halliday (2010) logged breeding-site abandonment 5 days pre-quake; groundwater/radon chemistry vs F14 precursor audit.

Name: Animal earthquake precursors (review)
Summary: Woith et al. (2018) meta-review of 729 reports found only 14 continuous time series and pervasive foreshock confounding.

Name: Jaytee, the dog who knows
Summary: Sheldrake (1999) owner-return anticipation claim vs Wiseman, Smith & Milton (1998) controlled null replication.

Name: Oscar the cat
Summary: Dosa (2007) nursing-home case report of curling beside terminally ill patients; volatile ketotic odor cues untested under blinding.

Name: Food-anticipatory activity
Summary: Mammalian food-entrainable circadian oscillator ramps locomotion prior to scheduled daily meals from past schedule history.

Name: Plant circadian anticipation of dawn
Summary: Arabidopsis starch-degradation arithmetic divides stored night reserves by endogenous clock time remaining until dawn.

Name: Migratory restlessness (Zugunruhe)
Summary: Photoperiod and circannual clock genes trigger seasonal migratory preparation weeks before winter onset.

Name: Physarum anticipates periodic shocks
Summary: Saigusa et al. (2008) slime-mold slowdown at periodic cold-dry intervals reflects damped biochemical oscillation from prior pulses.

Name: Adaptive prediction in microbes
Summary: Tagkopoulos et al. (2008): E. coli switches from temperature to anaerobic pathways because evolutionary history coupled both cues.

Name: Periodical cicadas, 13 and 17 years
Summary: Magicicada xylem-flux seasonal counting emerges synchronously at prime intervals avoiding predator resonance (Yoshimura 1997).

Name: Panagrolaimus kolymaensis revived after about 46,000 years
Summary: Shatilovich et al. (2023) revived Siberian permafrost nematodes via trehalose/anhydrobiosis metabolic suspension.

Name: Silene stenophylla regenerated from about 32,000-year-old tissue
Summary: Yashina et al. (2012) regenerated fertile plants from Pleistocene squirrel-burrow placental fruit tissue in vitro.

Name: Sacred lotus seed about 1300 years old germinated
Summary: Shen-Miller et al. (1995) radiocarbon-dated Nelumbo nucifera seed germinated via impermeable pericarp and L-isoaspartyl methyltransferase repair.

Name: Tardigrade cryptobiosis
Summary: Reversible tun desiccation arrest suspending internal biological turnover while ambient proper time advances.

Name: Mpemba effect
Summary: History-dependent relaxation rates in warm vs cool water/colloids; contested experimentally and purely causal forward dynamics.
